title: Halo Campaign Evolved Signals Xbox's Strategy for the Next 3 Years
excerpt: Halo: Campaign Evolved signals Xbox's reset under Sharma. By prioritizing a flagship remake, Xbox shifts to evolving core pillars over chasing new IP for the next three years.
